summary: First-finish smoke test of Pathfinder AI (backend + frontend). All key backend endpoints (auth, questions RBAC, admin CRUD, assessment with real Claude Sonnet 4.5, results ownership/RBAC, admin stats/results) work correctly. Frontend landing loads with hero-tag/cta-get-started, admin login redirects to /admin dashboard showing stat cards, /admin/questions renders new-question-btn, /admin/results shows submitted assessment with View link. No console/page errors.
passed: GET /api/auth/me returns current user with Bearer token
POST /api/questions as admin creates question (trait_map as List[str]); PUT 200; DELETE 200
POST /api/assessment/submit with all 18 seeded answers returns ai_report with summary, personality_analysis (non-empty), top_careers (3), recommended_stream, roadmap (3) via Claude Sonnet 4.5
GET /api/results/me returns created result; GET /api/results/{id} owner=200
Admin login (admin@pathfinder.ai / Admin@123) -> /admin with stat cards
/admin/results shows assessment row with View link
action_items: Minor doc note: auth endpoints return the JWT under the field name 'token' (not 'access_token'). Verify frontend AuthContext already reads 'token' from response (assumed working since admin login navigated to /admin).
Minor: POST /api/questions requires trait_map as List[str] with length == options length (not a dict). Admin UI form-trait-* inputs should send array.
notes: Student assessment E2E flow (Assessment.jsx option-*/next-btn/submit-assessment-btn -> /report/:id) was verified only at API level (POST /api/assessment/submit produced a real AI report id 64490677...). Full UI walk-through of the 18-question assessment and Report page career-card rendering deferred to full QA agent.
